structured_output.summary: The change replaces the not-implemented stub for DataView.prototype.setBigInt64 with a direct delegation to the shared set_view_value helper, using ElementType::BigInt64. Spec steps 1-3 are kept as comments above their code. Argument mapping is correct: byteOffset is args[0] (requestIndex), value is args[1], littleEndian is args[2], and the call is propagated with `?`. The method returns Ok(Value::Undefined) after the call. No test-specific branches, hardcoded results or swallowed errors appear in the diff. The 12 remaining failures are not-implemented errors from getBigInt64 and Number.isInteger in other built-ins, not defects here. The ToIndex/ToBigInt/bounds ordering (SetViewValue steps 3-15) lives in the helper, which is outside this diff and was not visible to me, so it was not reviewed. Its existence is implied by the successful build.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No changes needed for this ticket. The SetViewValue steps (ToIndex, ToBigInt, detached/out-of-bounds check, range check, SetValueInBuffer) are implemented in crate::support::typed_array::set_view_value, which was not part of this diff; it is shared with other DataView setters and should be checked there if it has not been. The remaining failing test262 cases depend on DataView.prototype.getBigInt64 and Number.isInteger, which are other tickets. The `let _ = new_target;` line is a harmless no-op, not a defect.
